pr.title: Friendlier greetings and calmer retries
pr.description:
Adds a configurable suffix to `greet()` and slows down the job queue retries.

The retry change follows the outage on Monday, when every worker retried at the same moment.
pr.author: octocat
pr.head: feature/greeting-suffix

prologue.why: Product wants a warmer greeting, and the job queue overloaded the database after an outage because all workers retried together.
prologue.what: `greet()` gets an optional suffix (default `!`), and the retry backoff starts later and adds jitter.

key_changes.headline: Retry backoff
key_changes.detail: Delays go from 100–800 ms to 250–2000 ms, with up to 10% random jitter.

review_focus.summary: Check that the longer backoff still fits inside the job timeout (4 retries now wait up to about 4 seconds).

chapters.title: Retry backoff with jitter
chapters.risk_reason: Changes timing for every job retry.
chapters.description: Raises the backoff delays and adds jitter so workers do not retry at the same moment.

chapters.title: Greeting suffix
chapters.risk_reason: Additive option with a default and tests.
chapters.description: Adds the `suffix` option and tests for the default and a custom value.
